metadata.selection: Minimum configured TSP objective, earliest step on ties; step 0 is initialization.
metadata.assignment_order: CSP variable order, original domain values; the closing edge is included in costs.
metadata.cost_semantics: tsp_tour_cost is raw cost, even for invalid assignments; valid_tour_cost is null when infeasible.
metadata.timing: Synchronized forward inference only; excludes XML parsing, transfer and JSON writes.
